Delivered switched on (2)

Additional accounting sources for non-project labor costs

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onProject ManagementProject Management · Cost Management and ControlIdea Lab
Derive accounting segments for non-project labor costs using additional worker assignment attributes. Labor Distribution provides additional worker assignment attributes for use in Subledger Accounting rules for non-project labor costs.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Needs setup or opt-in (9)

Billing Operations Workspace for billing readiness and dispute resolution

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control AgentsAgentic app
The Billing Operations Workspace represents a paradigm shift from administrative users carrying out routine, repetitive tasks across separate applications, to a unified experience underpinned by policy-driven automated actions.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Ingest Contract Documents Using AI

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Use Ingest Contract Documents Using AI feature to efficiently bring existing contract documents into Enterprise Contracts and convert them into contract records with less manual effort.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Payroll encumbrance distribution to Projects

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Cost Management and Control
Distribute and track Oracle Fusion Payroll generated encumbrances as project labor commitments. Connecting payroll encumbering cycles to project financials allows for the continuous consumption of budget, applying controls to reserve funds for anticipated labor costs, and automatically liquidates commitments when actual payroll costs post.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Prevent data discrepancies between Project Contracts and Revenue Management

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set up (Service Request Required)Project ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Prevent data discrepancies across Project Contracts and Revenue Management by extracting all simultaneously generated project contract revenue distributions skipped during the previous extract, and by recording satisfaction percentage reversals and rebookings in the appropriate accounting period.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Service Request Required · Oracle source

Prevent deletion of project intercompany and interproject invoices pending completion in Payables

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set up (Service Request Required)Project ManagementProject Management · Billing and Revenue Management
Prevent data discrepancies across Project Contracts, Receivables, and Payables by restricting the deletion of Payables invoices from the following sources when the corresponding project intercompany or interproject invoices are in Accepted status in Project Contracts: Previously, users could delete invoices in Not Validated status from the Manage Invoices page in Payables, or delete invoices rejected during Payables…
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Service Request Required · Oracle source

Project Financial Control Agents

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Financial Control AgentsAI agent Redwood Platform
Gain clear insight into project costs, capitalization, and reconciliation to the general ledger to improve financial oversight and keep projects aligned with business objectives.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Project Planning Workspace for project initiation and budget planning

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upProject ManagementProject Management · Project Planning AgentsAgentic app
Accelerate the path from project proposal through staffing with Project Planning Workspace. AI-powered capabilities help you assess qualified sales opportunities, generate proposals, create structured project plans, produce governed budgets, and staff approved demand with qualified, available people.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Track progress with task output quantities

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-inProject ManagementProject Management · Planning, Scheduling, and Forecasting
Measure and track work using output quantities, also known as work quantities. Output quantities represent measurable units of work, such as kilometers of pipeline installed or cubic feet of concrete poured.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In · Oracle source

Updated labor schedule management pages

Impact on upgrade: lowOpt-inProject ManagementProject Management · Grant ManagementRedwood Platform
Experience improved labor schedule management through redesigned pages that offer a streamlined flow of analysis and maintenance. New distribution level management aid in identifying gaps and over allocations, enabling faster and more accurate adjustments to labor distribution in both the near and long term.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Opt In · Oracle source
